title: Uncharted Territory

{{Quest infobox | name = Uncharted Territory | map = [[Image:Uncharted_Territory_map.jpg|250px]] | campaign = Nightfall | region = Realm of Torment | type = Primary | given by = [[Pehai]] | given at = [[Gate of Torment]] | preceded by = [[Ruins of Morah]] | followed by = [[Gate of Pain]]
[[Breaking the Broken]] }} ==Quest information== ===Requirements=== [[Dunkoro]] must be in your party. ===Objectives=== * Bring Dunkoro to meet with [[Kormir]] in [[Nightfallen Jahai]]. * Travel through Nightfallen Jahai with Kormir and Dunkoro. * Speak with the [[Tortured Sunspear]]. * See [[Jarindok]] for your reward. ===Reward=== * 2,500 [[Experience]] * 200 [[Gold]] * 100 [[Lightbringer Points]] ==Walkthrough== Walk out north at [[Gate of Torment]] into Nightfallen Jahai. Speak with Kormir and follow the way north. Take care to [[aggro]] only one group at a time as two groups will probably kill you; the [[mob]]s here are significantly more difficult than those in [[Kourna]] and [[Vabbi]] and you're under the effect of [[Edge of Reason]]. Speak with the Tortured Sunspear. After a [[cinematic]] you will find yourself in [[Gate of Pain (outpost)|Gate of Pain]]. ===Easier method=== Alternatively, this quest can be done easily with a single player equipped to [[Guide_to_running|run]] through enemies. Go out into Nightfallen Jahai with Dunkoro in your party to trigger Kormir's appearance, then talk to her to trigger the next objective to bring the two of them to the Tortured Sunspear. Rather than fighting through numerous groups of enemies, use speed boosts and skills such as [[Shadow Form]] to run to [[Gate of Pain]]. After the whole party is brought into the outpost, zone back out and talk to the Tortured Sunspear with Dunkoro in your party. ==NPCs== ===Allies=== *{{p}} 20 [[Kormir]] *{{x}} 10 [[Tortured Sunspear]] ==Dialogue== ===Initial dialogue=== '''Pehai''' : ''"You there! You're one of the Sunspears, right? I can't believe any of you actually showed up...alive, I mean. Well, I guess Kormir was right about you Sunspears. What's that? Yeah, I know Kormir. Oh, that reminds me. '''Kormir''' said I should send you and '''Dunkoro''' out to '''Nightfall Jahai''' to meet her as soon as you arrived. She wants your help coming up with a plan. Huh. What do you know? I never thought I'd actually have to deliver that message."'' {{offer dialog |accept = Kormir's here? We have to see her! |decline = Right, and when we get out there your spirit friends take our souls. No thanks. |ask = '''Kormir''' is waiting for you and '''Dunkoro''' in '''Nightfallen Jahai'''. }} ===Intermediate dialogue=== '''Kormir''' : ''"! Dunkoro! It is good to see you. As you can see, I am in a bit of a...predicament. Let's get moving. I'll explain as we go."'' ===Intermediate dialogue 2=== :'''Dunkoro:''' ''"What is this, Kormir? And, more importantly, what are you doing here?"'' :'''Kormir:''' ''"This is Nightfallen Jahai. It is but a shadow of the [[Jahai Bluffs]] of our world. [[Abaddon]] has dreamed it into being, and when the dream is complete, the bluffs will fall into night. This is what Abaddon will do to our world if not stopped."'' :'''Kormir:''' ''"As for me, I found myself trapped here, pulled bodily into this realm. I am still blind, yet can sense pain around me. I fear that I, like others, have been contaminated by Abaddon's touch, and my body and spirit are now bound here by that foul taint."'' :'''Kormir:''' ''"All those who come into contact with Abaddon are fated to come here. It is the only way to prevent their contamination of the rest of reality. As long as Abaddon's presence remains, he will corrupt all he can reach, and doom them to eternal torment here."'' :'''Kormir''' ''"The Dark God of Secrets was contained here once; unable to harm those of our world. But he has begun to break free, and he moves the walls of his prison outward. Unless we defeat him, he will turn all of [[Elona]] into a nightmare realm like this one."'' :'''Dunkoro''' ''"Defeat him? Kormir, that's madness. How can we fight a god? There must be something else we can do; some other way to stop this from happening."'' :'''Kormir''' ''"The time for caution has passed, Dunkoro. Every moment we delay is another moment Abaddon uses to grow stronger and reach further into Elona. I need your strategic insights, not your doubts. We need a plan."'' :'''Dunkoro''' ''"A plan? For defeating a god? That may be beyond my strategic capabilities."'' ;Tortured Sunspear :''Ah, there you are . Kormir has asked me to show you something.'' :{{yes|ingame}} '''What did Kormir want you to show us?''' ::''Are you sure you're ready to move on? We're entering into dangerous territory.'' ::{{yes|ingame}} '''We are ready.''' (sent to [[Uncharted Territory (cinematic)]]) ::{{no|ingame}} '''We are not ready yet.''' ===Reward dialogue=== '''Jarindok''' : ''"Ah, ! Kormir told me you would be coming. She's gone ahead into the Domain of Pain to scout the area. When you're ready, you should catch up with her. The battlements are heavily guarded, so you should be careful."'' ==Notes== *Since you are unlikely to return to this area except to capture [[elite skill]]s, it would be worth the time to open the [[treasure]] on the eastern side of Nightfallen Jahai near the [[Shepherd of Dementia]] as you pass by.
